_doc: Friends & Bonds (systems/bonds.js): friendships beyond romance. A bond forms with someone you know well (relationship score >= formAt), carries a kind and a strength 0..100 that grows through shared deeds and fades with neglect. Milestones: sworn kinship by oath, a mentor teaching you a skill, a protégé you raise into a capable ally. Friends act (aid in battle, a loan when your purse is empty, vouching, warnings of plots and rumours, visits) and can betray — as can you.

round.label: shared a round at the inn

lines.formed: {name} counts you a friend now — not a passing acquaintance, but someone they would stand beside.
lines.rivalFriend: Once you and {name} could hardly share a room. Somewhere along the way the quarrel turned into something else: they call you friend now, and mean it.
lines.drinkKind: {name} has become your drinking companion — the one who saves you a seat at the inn.
lines.oath: Before {place}, you and {name} swear the old oath: blood for blood, hearth for hearth. From this day you are {sworn}.
lines.oathFailed: {name} hesitates at the last, and will not swear it. "Not yet," they say. "Ask me again when we have been through more."
lines.mentorStart: {name} agrees to teach you what they know of {skill}. Keep company with them, and you will learn.
lines.mentorDone: {name} has taught you all they know of {skill}. "There's nothing more I can show you," they say, and they look proud.
lines.protegeStart: You take {name}, a youth of {age}, under your wing. Visit them in {town} and teach them {skill}; in a few years they may be someone.
lines.protegeGrown: {name}, the youth you took under your wing, has grown into a capable {skill} and a loyal friend. They would serve you, if you asked.
lines.visit: {name} comes to find you in {town}, just to see how you fare. You talk until the candles gutter.
lines.aidDebt: {name} hears your purse is empty and presses {amount} gold into your hand. "Pay me when you can."
lines.warnPlot: {name} got wind of what {enemy} was planning and warned you in time.
lines.warnRumour: {name} sends word from {town}: "They're saying {telling} — I thought you should know."
lines.vouch: {name} speaks for you before the folk of {realm}: an honest friend's word is worth more than gold.
lines.died: {name}, your {kind}, has died{cause}. The friendship ends as all things do.
lines.drifted: You and {name} have drifted apart. Too long without a word between you.
lines.betrayBribe: {name} took {rival}'s coin and sold what they knew of you. The friendship is over.
lines.betraySlight: {name} has had enough of being taken for granted. They turn on you, and tell anyone who'll listen what you are.
lines.betrayKin: {name} has learnt what you did to their family. "You were my friend," they say, and spit at your feet.
lines.betrayStole: {name} has vanished from your company with {amount} gold from your purse.
lines.youBetray: You sold {name}'s confidences for {amount} gold. They will know who told.
lines.inherited: {count} of {old}'s old friends remember the House, and will be friends to you too.
lines.repaid: You repay {name} the {amount} gold they lent you. "I never doubted it," they say.
lines.overdue: {name} lent you {amount} gold, and the day to repay it has come and gone. They have not said anything — yet.
